name: Mobility Plus Boise
old_description: Mobility products play a vital role in the lives of many people, offering enhanced independence and freedom of movement. Whether you need mobility aids due to age-related issues, temporary injuries, or disabilities, At Mobility Plus Boise we got it all!
about:
Mobility Plus Boise operates a retail and service location at 339 N. Milwaukee Street in Boise, Idaho. The business is described as locally owned and operated; reviews identify Brian and Wendy as the proprietors who manage day-to-day operations. No founding year is disclosed in the available material.

The store sells and rents mobility equipment including mobility scooters, power wheelchairs, lift chairs, and stair lifts from brands such as Jazzy. Inventory covers both new and pre-owned units, with all used items inspected before sale. Services include white-glove delivery, professional setup, and repair work. The operation runs from a single Boise storefront; headcount and facility size are not published.

Customers range from individuals needing short-term rentals for travel or recovery to seniors and people with disabilities seeking long-term mobility aids. An in-home personal trainer noted commercial collaboration for senior clients, and out-of-state families have arranged equipment for relatives in local care facilities. The shop serves the Boise metropolitan area.

The company emphasizes quality assurance on every unit, expert guidance during selection, competitive pricing with frequent promotions, and a community-focused local presence as its distinguishing commitments.
